statement: Marco Rossi proposed SOW value case wording stating that the primary value driver for the engagement was the reduction of fresh food waste, measured as a percentage of fresh net sales against an agreed baseline.
value: reduction of fresh food waste as percentage of fresh net sales against agreed baseline

statement: Marco Rossi proposed SOW wording that both parties expected a return on the initial investment within twelve months of contract signature.
value: return within twelve months of contract signature

statement: Marco Rossi stated that he deliberately wrote "expect" rather than "guarantee" in the SOW value case because delivery depended on data readiness and resourcing on both sides.
Marco Rossi asked that if the customer's legal team wanted to tighten the value case wording they discuss it rather than send a redline.
Marco Rossi added a quarterly business review with a written report to the SOW as an obligation on RELEX.
value: quarterly business review with written report, obligation on RELEX

statement: Lena Fischer reported that the customer's legal team had replaced "Both parties expect" with "RELEX anticipates" in the SOW value case wording.
Lena Fischer reported that the customer's legal team wanted the waste baseline defined in the contract rather than agreed later.
Lena Fischer stated that she had told the legal team the baseline could not be defined before knowing what was being measured, so that request was probably not going anywhere.
Lena Fischer stated that she thought the legal team would insist on the change from "Both parties expect" to "RELEX anticipates".
fact_key: legal insistence on RELEX anticipates wording

statement: Marco Rossi accepted the wording "RELEX anticipates", stating it said the same thing.
responds_to: The customer legal team's change from "Both parties expect" to "RELEX anticipates", relayed by Lena Fischer on 25 June 2024

statement: Marco Rossi agreed with Lena Fischer that the waste baseline could not be defined yet.
responds_to: Lena Fischer's statement of 25 June 2024 that the baseline cannot be defined before knowing what is being measured

statement: Marco Rossi proposed wording the baseline clause as "a baseline to be agreed in writing prior to go-live of the fresh phase", giving the legal team a commitment and RELEX room.
value: a baseline to be agreed in writing prior to go-live of the fresh phase

statement: Lena Fischer confirmed that Marco Rossi's baseline wording, "a baseline to be agreed in writing prior to go-live of the fresh phase", was in the SOW.
value: a baseline to be agreed in writing prior to go-live of the fresh phase
responds_to: Marco Rossi's proposed baseline wording of 26 June 2024

statement: Lena Fischer stated on 2 July 2024 that the signed version of the SOW was going out that week.
value: signed version going out week of 2 July 2024
